```yaml
name: Contributor Actions

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_ts_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_ts_changes }}
      has_docs_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_docs_changes }}
      has_config_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_config_changes }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Detect file changes
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            has_ts_changes:
              - '**/*.ts'
              - '**/*.tsx'
              - '**/*.js'
              - '**/*.jsx'
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'yarn.lock'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
            has_docs_changes:
              - '**/*.md'
              - 'docs/**'
            has_config_changes:
              - '.github/**'
              - 'tsconfig.json'
              - 'eslint.config.*'
              - 'prettier.config.*'

  lint-and-typecheck:
    name: Lint & Type Check
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_ts_changes == 'true' || needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_config_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Run Type Check
        run: pnpm typecheck

  test:
    name: Run Tests
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_ts_changes == 'true' || needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_config_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run Tests
        run: pnpm test

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_ts_changes == 'true' || needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_config_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build

  status-check:
    name: Status Check
    needs: [detect-changes, lint-and-typecheck, test, build]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check job statuses
        run: |
          echo "Lint & Type Check: ${{ needs.lint-and-typecheck.result }}"
          echo "Test: ${{ needs.test.result }}"
          echo "Build: ${{ needs.build.result }}"
          
          if [[ "${{ needs.lint-and-typecheck.result }}" == "success" || "${{ needs.lint-and-typecheck.result }}" == "skipped" ]] && \
             [[ "${{ needs.test.result }}" == "success" || "${{ needs.test.result }}" == "skipped" ]] && \
             [[ "${{ needs.build.result }}" == "success" || "${{ needs.build.result }}" == "skipped" ]]; then
            echo "All checks passed or skipped"
            exit 0
          else
            echo "Some checks failed"
            exit 1
          fi
```
